items.title: Sample headline — top of the morning brief
items.summary: Edit public/data/news.json to control which articles appear on the page. Each item needs an id, title, source, category, pubDate (ISO 8601), summary, and link.

items.title: Defense-category card sample
items.summary: Cards are colour-coded by category. Valid categories: overview, defense, strategic, domestic, space, local.

items.title: Strategic-category card sample
items.summary: The card layout grid is responsive: 1 column on mobile, 2 on tablet, 3 on desktop.

items.title: Domestic-category card sample
items.summary: Timestamps use ISO 8601 (e.g. 2026-05-22T18:00:00.000Z) and render as relative time on the card.

items.title: Space-category card sample
items.summary: To swap the data source later, replace the fetch call in components/news/NewsFeed.tsx — it currently fetches /data/news.json from the public/ directory.

items.title: Local-category card sample
items.summary: The Refresh button re-fetches this JSON with a cache-buster query string, so changes you upload to GoDaddy show up immediately.
